four-samples.alt: Four copies of the same population of 48 students in 6 homerooms of 8, with selected students in plum. Simple random sample: any 8 of the 48, scattered. Stratified random sample: the grades are strata, two homerooms each, and 3 students are chosen at random from each grade. Cluster sample: 2 whole homerooms chosen at random. Systematic random sample: a random start at the 3rd student, then every 6th student in order.
